release.releaseNotes:
Interactive cloud latency graph
• Pinch horizontally to zoom time; pinch vertically to zoom latency.
• Drag to explore up to 30 days of shared cloud history.
• Tap a recorded point for a crosshair, time, average and peak latency.
• Double-tap resets the graph to the latest hour.
• All range and scale buttons removed; newest-edge following pauses during inspection.
• Cloud monitor records every minute independently; phone RTT stays a separate readout.
